summary: Iter281 tested provider health / low-balance alerts, the profile gate, bulk number and email lookup, the Bird email check, and the iter280 fixes. Backend: new pytest file passes 25/25 and the iter279 regression passes 11/11. bird_only_outbound_unit_test.js passes 22/22. New provider_health_unit_test.js passes 19/19. Live check: Infobip is currently hidden. A US search returns only multitel numbers, and LT local (normally Infobip, level 0) falls back to multitel. UI works: lookup tabs; single number and email checks; bulk paste, CSV upload, summary and CSV download for numbers and emails; profile banner; the Quick call submit opens the 'First, add your details' dialog; landing card, home tile and FAQ order. No blocking bugs. Admin alert emails never reach moxxcompany@gmail.com in preview (see below).

minor.issue: A mail sender IS configured in preview, so the review note saying no sender is set is wrong. Every alert email fails: Resend returns 403 'domain is not verified', then the fallback returns 'API Key is not enabled'. Telegram alerts are delivered. No email has reached moxxcompany@gmail.com.

number-lookup and email-check transactions show the description 'Number lookup · ' / 'Email check · ', with an empty part after the separator. lookup.js charge() saves `ref`, but wallet.js reads metadata.phoneNumber or metadata.count. Save metadata:{phoneNumber} for single checks and metadata:{count} for bulk runs, or make wallet.js read ref.

skipped = all - unique valid, so duplicates are counted as 'skipped (not a valid number/email)'. Example: Support@Google.com next to support@google.com gives skipped=2 when only 1 item is invalid. Report duplicates separately.

Runs synchronously with a pool of 10. 1000 Bird calls can take longer than the ingress or proxy timeout (~60-100s). The wallet is already charged and rows are stored, but the client gets no response, and only 20 history rows are shown. Consider a background job with polling, or a batch-results endpoint.
adminMail runs only after `await _bot.sendMessage` succeeds. If Telegram fails, no email is sent either. provider-health.alert() does this correctly.

The WARN and STOP alerts share one lowAlertAt timestamp (12h throttle). A drop from $15 to under $10 within 12h sends no alert saying numbers are now hidden. State is kept in memory only, so every restart sends the alerts again (duplicates seen in logs).

ui_bugs.issue: The client count includes CSV header cells and other invalid tokens. Example: '3 items · up to $0.045' for a header plus 2 numbers. The server then skips 1. The estimate is slightly high, but nothing is wrongly charged.

integration_issues.issue: Could not verify in preview. The softphone line never registers ('Not connected', simulated numbers), and dial() is only called once status is ready. Checked by code review only (rtc.js L77-78). The server-side SIP gate in voice-service L3389-3396 also exists.

The QA account has no campaign in a startable state, so this was not run in the UI. The API returns 428 for /campaigns and /campaigns/:id/start, and api.js handles every 428 the same way (the Quick call dialog was verified).

issues: Sidebar nav item (nav.js), dashboard NewProducts.js and landing menu.js still say 'Number lookup'. menu.js says '$0.015 each' and does not mention email.
The page eyebrow 'PHONE NUMBERS' sits above the title 'Number & email lookup'.
The dialog title 'Your details for numbers' / 'Carriers register every number...' is out of date now that details are also needed for calls.

action_items: Fix admin email delivery: verify the Resend sender domain, or fix the fallback mail API key. Alerts currently never reach moxxcompany@gmail.com.
lookup.js charge(): store metadata.phoneNumber (single) / metadata.count (bulk) so wallet history descriptions are complete.
Count duplicates separately from invalid items in the bulk 'skipped' value, or dedupe without calling duplicates 'not valid'.
Consider an async or background flow for large bulk runs (1000 items) so ingress timeouts don't lose results after the wallet is charged.
balance-monitor sendAlert: send the admin email even when Telegram fails.
Update the 'Number lookup' labels in nav.js, NewProducts.js and landing menu.js to cover email, and fix the 'PHONE NUMBERS' eyebrow on the lookup page.
Optional: give provider-health a separate STOP-crossing alert and keep alert timestamps across restarts.
critical_code_review_comments: provider-health isDown/isLow logic is correct. It never hides both providers, the EUR->USD conversion works, and Bird 402 is treated as balance 0.
callGate covers every listed POST route. Account check uses legalProfile.completedAt. GET routes are not gated.
api.js re-sends the request after the profile is saved. If the dialog is closed, a 428 ApiError is thrown and the page shows its error.
rtc.js dial returns null on cancel. The Softphone component does not tell the user why nothing happened (only the dialog closes).

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all tested flows pass; softphone and campaign-start gates not UI-verifiable in preview)
